title: verdict
description: One tester's review of one round. Ask for changes only when you list the items; approve when nothing is left that matters.

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

round.description: The review round this verdict belongs to, counting from 1.

outcome.description: approve accepts the work as it stands; changes sends it back with items.

summary.description: Your overall note to the engineer.

items.description: The individual findings. Required when the outcome is changes; may be empty on an approval.
Asking for changes requires at least one item.

feedback_item.description: One concrete finding. A violation of a rules file uses category "rules" and is always a blocker.

id.description: Unique within the bead across rounds, for example "qa-r1-3"; the engineer answers it by this id.

severity.description: blocker must be fixed, major is a real problem, minor is worth fixing, nit is taste.

category.description: Free-form grouping. Use "rules" for a violation of a rules file; such items must be blockers.

detail.description: What is wrong and why it matters.

file.description: Path the item refers to, relative to the repository root.

line.description: 1-based line in file; omit when it does not apply.

suggestion.description: The fix you propose, code included when that is clearer.

status.description: Where the item stands. Omit on a first review (it is open); on a re-review set it for every item you carry over.

severity.description: A rules violation is always a blocker.
